testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/saved-carts-validate-edit-saved-cart.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Saved Carts > validate edit saved cart functionality

scenario.summary: The signed-in my-account user moves an existing saved cart to the cart, checks the duplicate-name error, saves a runtime copy, edits its quantity and name (blank / invalid / valid), moves it back and checks product and quantity, removes its line, checks an all-product-types saved cart (configurable, grouped, bundle, simple with add-on), clears another runtime copy and bulk-deletes the runtime carts.
steps: Signed in through the shared storageState; Saved Carts, open the Edit page of editActionCartName, read its first product name, Move Items To Cart (toast, Cart heading)
Save Cart with an existing saved-cart name (deleteSaveCartName) -> duplicate-name error; save as '<runtimeBaseName> <ts>' -> saved toast; empty the cart

Edit the runtime cart: quantity -> Updated_Product_Quantity (changes saved toast, unit and total price visible); name blank -> required; name with symbols -> alphanumeric error; valid '<editRuntimeBaseName> <ts>' -> saved
Move the edited cart to the cart: product name contains the read name, quantity equals Updated_Product_Quantity; empty the cart
Edit the renamed cart, remove its item: 'No items are in your Saved Cart.'

Open savedCartWithAllTypeProduct: configurable name, SKU, personalization texts, variant attributes (best-effort), grouped name (child best-effort), bundle name, SKU and 3 children, simple name, checkbox add-on, SKU
Move editActionCartName to the cart again, save as '<runtimeBaseName> <ts+1>', Clear All Items (record deleted toast, empty message), empty the cart
Filter runtime carts, bulk delete them by id: deleted toast, 'No records found.'; afterEach sweeps leftovers
stateChanges: The account's cart is filled by Move To Cart and emptied several times
Runtime saved carts '<runtimeBaseName> <ts>', '<editRuntimeBaseName> <ts>', '<runtimeBaseName> <ts+1>' are created, edited and deleted by the test; existing saved carts are only read
assertions: Edit Saved Cart / Cart headings; moved, saved, changes-saved, record(s)-deleted toasts
Duplicate-name, required-name and alphanumeric-name validation messages
Edited quantity kept in the saved cart and in the cart; moved product name in the cart
Empty saved-cart message; all-product-types cart shows the configured product names, SKUs, personalization, bundle children, add-on
'No records found.' after the bulk delete
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts AUTH_SPECS = my-account/**), signed in through the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts. That setup signs in with getMyAccountUser() (testim-migrated/src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, whose username is requireEnv('MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME') (testim-migrated/src/config/env.ts:80; process.env, then .env.<env>, then .env). Source 0 records that credential (masked; kind properties = environment variable). On migration the test declares it before reading any owned record: await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username) - the same value the setup signed in with, so the declared account is the signed-in one. No spec data file holds it

LEASE NOTE: every webstore-auth spec shares this one account; declaring it leases the account per test (useExisting waits while another test holds it), so migrated my-account specs run one at a time on it (protects counts from parallel runtime carts, but lengthens the phase that must finish inside the storageState session's 1-hour token)

OWNERSHIP: the saved cart must belong to the signed-in (declared) account: need savedCart links owner to @user.userId (SAVED_CART_OF_USER_WITH_PRODUCTS: ZnodeOrder.UserId = @owner, class SavedCarts, store, at least one active non-add-on product, owner's saved-cart count >= minSavedCarts), so it resolves at test start when the test declares the account (testData.useExisting); strategy migrate
editActionCartName ('Testim Save Cart 4', used in steps 1 and 6) -> savedCart.name. minSavedCarts 1

deleteSaveCartName is used here only as an EXISTING saved-cart name of the account, to trigger 'Name already in use': any saved cart name of the account does it, so it maps to savedCart.name too (the moved copy is saved under the resolved cart's own name). In the action-column spec the same key is a runtime prefix instead

MISSING KEY (proposed SAVED_CART_OF_USER_WITH_ALL_PRODUCT_TYPES, entity saved_cart, read-only): a saved cart of the declared account on the store holding a configurable product line with personalization values and its variant attributes, a grouped product with a child line, a bundle product with 3 child products, and a simple product with a checkbox add-on; params owner (@user.userId), store; outputs name, configurableName, configurableSku, configurablePersonalization1..2, configurableVariant1..3, groupName, groupChildName, bundleName, bundleSku, bundleChild1..3 (sku - name), simpleName, simpleSku, simpleAddOnName. Would supply savedCartWithAllTypeProduct and every product value of step 5 (configSku/bundleSku are locator args). Need left out; values kept as config/expected-output until the key exists. The spec notes atstage drift (variants not rendered, grouped child unavailable)
Runtime cart names (runtimeBaseName, editRuntimeBaseName) are created-by-test prefixes; Updated_Product_Quantity is a test setting (config)
Not profiled: no profile observation exists for this test

Re-mapped to new keys (2026-11-01): allTypesCart = SAVED_CART_OF_USER_WITH_ALL_PRODUCT_TYPES (owner @user.userId, minBundleChildren 3, minVariantAttributes 3, minPersonalizations 2, store): savedCartWithAllTypeProduct -> name, configurableProductName -> configurableName, configProductSKU and configSku -> configurableSku, personalizationText1/2 -> configurablePersonalization1/2, groupProductName -> groupName, group_ChildProductName -> groupChildName, bundleProductName -> bundleName, bundleProductSKU and bundleSku -> bundleSku, bundle_childProductName1..3 -> bundleChild1Name..bundleChild3Name, simpleProductName -> simpleName, checkboxProductName -> simpleAddOnName, simpleProductSKU -> simpleSku (checked against the pending query). Several sources are formatted labels the migrated spec must build from outputs: 'SKU: <sku>', '<sku> - <name>' (bundleChildNSku + bundleChildNName), '<add-on group> : <add-on name>' (simpleAddOnGroupName + simpleAddOnName), '<attribute> : <value>' personalizations. LEFT WITHOUT output: variant1..3 ('Bulb Size :  Small', 'Color :  White', 'Technology :  LED') - the query returns no variant attribute names/values (only configurableVariantSku); they stay data of allTypesCart until the query returns them (or the spec drops them; it already notes atstage does not render variants). Strategy migrate
